integrity: Proof reconstructed from the defining product rule, modular divisibility and parity; finite checks reproduced separately; no claim of independent validation.
limitations: Exact characterization restricted to even numbers with precisely two distinct primes. Residual literature overlap risk includes an inaccessible primary paper.
title: Cototient-derivative rigidity for an even two-prime support
